<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex8012023-01-2014-55-54" status="finalized"><note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsa ba</rs>s de yan chad kyis don gyi mthu skyes kyi rjes 'gro'i khyab <choice><orig>pa °°°d</orig><reg>pa bshad</reg></choice> zin nas de'i ldog ston gsung ste de ltar na khyab pa grub pa na sgrub bya grubs du 'gyur bas 'di <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3780">chos mchog</rs> ltar</note> sgra spyi <choice><orig>mi‹ng›</orig><reg>ming</reg></choice> snang pa dgag pa la lnga ste |
            <note type="gloss">'di rtag pa rang rgyud du byed kyang rgyas thal gyur du byas so</note>'dod pa ma gnod pa'i thal 'gyur bstan pa dang | brjod pa snang pa brda dran pa la ltos pas 'bras bu'i rtsa ba'i thal 'gyur gyi khyab pa sgrub pa dang | 'dod pa la gnod <pb n="2b"/><lb n="2b1"/> thal 'gyur gyi khyab pa sgrub pa dang | de'i 'dod pa la gnod pa'i thal ba dang | bzlog pa'i rtags kyis rtsa ba'i sgrub bya sgrub pa'o ||</seg></TEI>
